title: Log 10 parameters in seconds
hook: Still writing your test results in a notebook?
caption:
Still writing test results in a notebook? 📓

ReefBuddy is a reef tank parameter log that fits all ten on one screen: temperature, salinity, pH, alkalinity, calcium, magnesium, nitrate, phosphate, ammonia and nitrite.
Type the numbers, save, done. Or tap Analyze and let the AI read them for you.

Free on iOS, no subscription. Link in bio.

What's your alkalinity target? 👇
